description: Header file defining hash table data structures, macros, and function prototypes for in-memory hash table implementation in C.

methods.name: dictGenHashFunction
methods.description: Generates a hash value from a buffer of bytes.

methods.name: dictCreate
methods.description: Creates a new hash table with specified type and private data.

methods.name: dictExpand
methods.description: Expands the hash table to a new size.

methods.name: dictAdd
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the hash table.

methods.name: dictReplace
methods.description: Replaces or adds a key-value pair in the hash table.

methods.name: dictDelete
methods.description: Deletes a key from the hash table.

methods.name: dictRelease
methods.description: Releases all resources associated with the hash table.

methods.name: dictFind
methods.description: Finds an entry by key in the hash table.

methods.name: dictGetIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for traversing the hash table.

methods.name: dictNext
methods.description: Returns the next entry in iteration.
